ruling: PLAY-D2 (PLAY-BRAND-20260915, CX2 §6): approved LEFT Xbox Series X-style controller from the two-controller comparison
operation: crop of the left composition only (PIL Image.crop, the PlayStation controller excluded), then a luminance-to-alpha mask (fully transparent at max(R,G,B) <= 10, opaque at >= 60, linear between) so the near-black render background becomes transparent and no rectangular edge can show on the charcoal gradient; no repaint, no resample
kept: dark sculpted body, asymmetric sticks, faceted circular D-pad, ABXY buttons
cyan/mint left rim and violet right rim
